threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
Peers earn a better ROE - the competitive position looks weaker.
Promoter selling is a warning about insider conviction.
The company faced major shortages of nitrocellulose cotton (NC cotton) from its global supplier Nitrex due to diversion of supply to defense.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Which is… which was, you know, which actually made us, you know, lost revenue of about 4 to 5 odd crores, you know, in the month of March, so we almost lost orders of 4 to 5 crores in March from Wembley." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Management noted geopolitical, currency and crude-linked raw material volatility.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Despite geopolitical, currency and crude-linked raw material volatility, profitability was protected through calibrated pricing, sourcing optimisation, product-mix improvements and tighter operational controls — supporting sustainable margins over the medium..." (concall ppt - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Jun, Dec) are still in the cycle.
